decisions.reason: The accepted post-mint transaction controls do not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, access, or destination behavior.
The decision concerns post-mint tip and random-referral transactions, not the deferred Transak conversion and mint flow.
The decision changes how a no-referral award is finalized but does not change the $15 allocation amounts or prize-pool target.
The accepted controls occur after minting and do not change the USDC approval-to-mint execution requirement.
The source selects a success-modal interaction design and does not necessarily revise the supplied FAQ copy; its high-level random-allocation description remains valid.

value_updates.tip_submission_control: After a successful mint, show an optional "Send $X tip (separate tx)" button in the success modal.

decisions.reason: The source does not change which payment methods are disclosed or selectable.
Manual post-mint reward finalization does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded and counted.
The accepted success-modal controls do not affect ETH excess-value calculation, currency, or refund method.
Under the accepted manual-finalization flow, a no-referral commission does not exist for accounting or display until the separate finalization transaction awards it.

value_updates.commission_count_reconciliation_rule: Displayed commission totals must account for one commission per referred primary mint and for each no-referral primary mint whose separate random-referral finalization transaction has completed; secondary-market sales are excluded.
value_updates.random_commission_visibility: After the separate random-referral finalization transaction awards a no-referral commission, it must be displayed on the dashboard and in NFT attributes; before finalization, there is no random commission to display.
